simple.summary: חֶבֶר (cheber) means a society ; also a spell First listed occurrence: Deut 18 11.

definitions.full: H2267. cheber חֶ֫בֶר noun [masculine] company, association, spell — absolute חָ֑בֶר Deut 18:11 2 t.; construct חֶבֶר Hosea 6:9 ; plural חֲבָרִים Psa 58:6 , suffix חֲבָרַיִךְ Isa 47:9 , 11 — 1 company, band of (bad) priests Hosea 6:9 . 2 association, society (abstract), only in חָ֑בֶר בֵּית Prov 21:9 = 25:24 house of association , i. e. shared with a contentious woman (house in common, see RVm VB). 3 spell : a. as accusative of congnate meaning with verb with חָבַר (q. v.) Deut 18:11 ; Psa 58:6 . b. alone, of Babylonian magic Isa 47:9 , 11 (see Len Chald. Magic [1878]; Magie u. Wahrsage-kunst 1878; Scholz G-tzendienst u. Zauberwesen, 1877. 80 ff. Say TBA iii. 145 ff and Rel,. Bab 396 ff., 440 ff. ).
